title: Astronomers Have Detected an Exomoon for the First Time
summary: The system with the highest mass ratio among the planets and their moons in the solar system is Earth and the moon (approximately 1.2 percent); the mass ratios of the moons orbiting Jupiter and Saturn are much smaller.
